description: Fetch discussion board content for a course including forums, topics, and posts. Use this when the user asks about discussion boards, forum posts, class discussions, or wants to see what's been posted. Provide just courseId to list all forums and their topics. Add forumId to get topics and posts for a specific forum. Add both forumId and topicId to get all posts in a specific discussion topic.

courseId.description: Course ID to get discussion boards for.

forumId.description: Specific forum ID to get topics and posts for. If omitted, returns all forums.

topicId.description: Specific topic ID to get posts for. Requires forumId.

name: get_discussions
title: Get Discussions
